text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after forming a contract with Machikane Tannhauser,
she gazed up at the sky and let out a wistful thought.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man~. I kinda wanna try some fun and interesting training~.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, wait, that's not what I meant!
I'm not saying your training isn't fun, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I saw on TV yesterday that some people do stuff like
tag or triathlons as training!
choice_data_list: (I see. Doing that once in a while might be nice.)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: In that case! Allow me to propose the perfect training regimen!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Chairwoman?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I happened to be passing by when your voice caught my ear!
Now, back to the matter at hand!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The ideal training: one that hones cardiopulmonary function, decision-making, and mental fortitude,
all while functioning as a game!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Yes! Cops and Robbers!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, thanks to Machikane Tannhauser's spur-of-the-moment rallying,
ten Umamusume gathered—and headed out to an open field.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's huge~! I had no idea a place like this existed!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I heard it's open for training use.
We should be able to run at full speed here without any worries.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Alrighty then, without further ado, let me explain the rules~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We'll split into two teams: 5 Cops and 5 Robbers.
There's a time limit, so the Robbers run, and the Cops catch them!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If even one person on the Robber team evades capture until time runs out, the Robbers win!
If everyone gets caught, the Cops win!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
By the way, captured Robbers can be rescued by their teammates.
So the Cops can't let their guard down until the very end~.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the winning team gets deluxe parfaits as a prize~!
So let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
Rock-paper-scissors, split it up-pyoi!
Pyoi! ...Pyoi! ...Pyoi!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Alright, Robber team, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Robber Team
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We'll round them up in record time!
Police team, let's fire it up!

text_block_list.name: Police Team
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with both sides fired up, the game of Cops and Robbers began. However—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mrmph~~~! So frustrating, so frustrating, so frustrating!
I was this close~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man~, law and order is being maintained with an iron fist out there...
So, who's left uncaught—wait, only Tannhauser? Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, she might be Miss "Almost," but she delivers when it counts.
She can do it, right?! Show 'em what you've got, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hwah?! Could it be, could it really be... I'm the only one left?! Eep~!
What do I do? How do I rescue them?! Maybe I should flank around—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
......
Whatever, let's just go for it! Hyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...!
In those bushes—it's Tannhauser-san! All units, move in!

text_block_list.name: Police Team Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Machitan over there, halt right where you are!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hyah~! You found me way too fast~!

text_block_list.name: Police Team Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*! Scurrying around like that...!
Just give it up already~!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*!
Machitan can't come to a sudden halt~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We're rotating pursuit like a relay race!
Your capture is only a matter of time, surrender!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze, gasp, wheeze, gasp*...!
No waay~, I can't do that~! Cut me some slack here~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoaa! Machitan is incredible, isn't she?!
Darting left and right, she's been dodging them this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Robber Team Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
It's been almost 20 minutes. If I were being chased like that non-stop,
I'd be totally cornered by now...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's just the kind of gal Tannhauser is.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, wheeze, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Police team, this is getting us nowhere!
Switch to another formation—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: A gap! Toriyaaa~~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Machitan!! Woohoo, she's coming this way!
You're amazing, girl!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze, pant, pant, pant*,
U-Uwooooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Tannhauser brilliantly slipped past her pursuers
and somehow reached the jail, but then—

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ouchie!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She smacked her forehead straight into a tree and tumbled over.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser-san... captured...!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mnnnh~. I was this close, too~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, but seriously... you did great.
You never gave up. That's our girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tenacious game of evasion lasting tens of minutes. Her relentless drive to keep running
seemed to strike a chord with all the participating Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmph, so frustrating~. I was right there.
...I guess I really just can't seal the deal in the end.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yep~. Even in the junior club, I'd get sick at the most critical moments,
or get a nosebleed right before post time. Man, I really am Miss Almost.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —Indeed! Machikane Tannhauser certainly lacks a bit of polish.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman~! I'm back~.
...Wait, "lacks polish"?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! However, that is merely in the past! Your unwavering ambition
and unshakeable composure may seem plain at first glance, but they are qualities not just anyone can maintain!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In short, your future shines brightly! I am, to say the very least,
greatly looking forward to your future exploits! That is all! Hahaha~!
choice_data_list: She's like a whirlwind, isn't she...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Tehehe. She really cheered me up. Whenever I'm feeling down,
the Chairwoman will occasionally pop in and say something like that~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Chairwoman Akikawa said, while Machikane Tannhauser often fell just short,
there was a distinct feeling that she would accomplish something great one day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between today's game of Cops and Robbers and Chairwoman Akikawa's seal of approval...
Today made me genuinely look forward to what lay ahead for her.
